request.prompt: A restaurant business wants to port their legacy handling system into Foundry multi-agents. There is a front-end and back-end. Front end is what the customer interacts with, from making a reservation, check in, order food, pay bill and complete survey after visit. back-end is for the restaurant management to see orders, payments, but also handling the flow of food orders to kitchen and back to the restaurant at any stage. Provide a chat interface for the customer to ask questions, but also a bot for the staff and management to interact with. Given the large scale (5 floors, 250 seats, 4 or 5 meal times per day from lunch to later dinner), they question scale and performance
